title: Add direct MorphologyInfluenceRadiusBridge coverage
description:
## Summary

Add focused runtime tests for the morphology-to-influence-radius bridge used by implicit welded-surface skinning.

## User Mandate

> "Review this external audit + follow up delta audit and synthesize to durable tasks"

STRICT. This task is created only as the durable owner for the confirmed audit mechanism. Preserve the supplied audit provenance and keep the change limited to direct bridge coverage.

## Scope

- Add `MorphologyInfluenceRadiusBridgeTests.cs` in the runtime test assembly.
- Cover missing Body or limb data, non-finite and non-positive authored radii, deterministic fallback radius, and clamped midpoint thickness sampling.
- Preserve the existing bridge contract and the pure weight-authoring core.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Each fallback and midpoint-clamping branch has a direct assertion.
- Tests prove the bridge uses resolved morphology when valid data exists and the documented fallback otherwise.
- Existing skinned renderer and influence-radius tests remain green.

## Validation

Run focused runtime tests for `MorphologyInfluenceRadiusBridge`, runtime and runtime-test builds, and `git diff --check`. Unity execution is required before status changes to Done.

## Findings

Confirmed low-severity test-ownership gap from both supplied animation audits and current source. The bridge is currently exercised transitively through `CreatureSkinnedMeshRendererTests`; no dedicated test file exists.

## Blockers

None known.

## Next Step

Add direct branch coverage without changing runtime behavior.
